# Saif Ali — Ecommerce Growth Consultant for DTC Brands

> I help DTC brands turn ad clicks into customers — full-journey CRO across Meta ads, landing pages and Shopify.

Saif Ali is an ecommerce growth consultant working with direct-to-consumer (DTC) brands. His work covers the full buying journey: Meta ads, landing pages, Shopify product pages, offers, trust signals, and checkout.

## Services

- [Shopify CRO Consultant for DTC Brands](https://www.saifali.site/shopify-cro-consultant): the $750 fixed-price Shopify Conversion Fix Sprint — a 13-area full-journey teardown with the highest-impact fixes shipped in 7 days.
- [Ecommerce Growth Consultant](https://www.saifali.site/ecommerce-growth-consultant): ongoing growth ownership across ads, pages, and store.
- [Ecommerce UX Audit for Shopify Stores](https://www.saifali.site/ecommerce-ux-audit): the full-store teardown as a diagnosis report, no implementation.
- [Landing Page Optimization](https://www.saifali.site/landing-page-optimization): one ad-driven destination page rebuilt in 7 days, $750 fixed.
- [Case Studies and Shopify Teardowns](https://www.saifali.site/case-studies): the 13-area teardown methodology with worked examples, each clearly labelled as an independent methodology demo unless stated otherwise.
